main_text.head: Iacobitae in Officio diurno ad Vesperas diei Dominicae:
main_text.p: Virgo sancta, mater pura sine macula supplica Vnigenitum tuum, vt misericordias faciat omnibus nobis. Ibidem de Sanctis:

page.notes: The Syriac passages (Iacobitae rubrics and offices) are set in Syriac letters and could not be read reliably at this scan resolution, so each line is marked illegible; the letter counts are estimates. The Latin is clear. "remissio-nem" keeps its printed hyphen. Long s has been rendered as plain s ("nostra" in the first line is printed as "nofter"; read as noster, the "tra" form should be checked). The Syriac after "Paulo post in 2. Officio:" is likely a rubric and may run to more lines than were counted.
